text.description_html:
Acorn KPAJP, Southwestern Stainless Steel Cabinet Door Pull

Acorn's 3-1/2" Southwestern Stainless Steel Cabinet Pull was made by hand in a forge using hammer and anvil. It is perfect for rustic decors. The natural stainless steel finish (similar to antique nickel or pewter) is great for not only modern decors but also more traditional styles, able to accent this contemporary material with a natural feel that just seems to belong in any setting. This cabinet pull is the perfect way to bring out the beautiful textures and handmade charm that hardware had back when all iron was shaped by a blacksmith's hand.

For over a half a century authenticity and function have been the way Acorn Manufacturing has produced some of the highest quality hand forged hardware and accessories from some of New England's finest Blacksmiths for your home.

Specifications of the Southwestern Stainless Steel Cabinet Pull:

  • Finish: Stainless Steel
  • Material: Solid Stainless Steel
  • Length: 3-1/2"
  • Width: 1-1/8"
  • Projection: 1-3/16"
  • Package includes 1 pull and hardware for installation.

Sold individually. Due to the handmade craftsman nature of this product, all dimensions are approximate.
